page.title: Start a fuzzing run
page.description: Upload a contract, pick what to break, launch. Three steps, about two minutes.

upload.heading: Step 1 — Upload your contract
upload.description: Drop in the compiled .wasm file for your Soroban contract. CrashLab reads its exported functions and proposes fuzz targets on the next step.
upload.maxSize: Maximum size: 16MB. Only .wasm files are accepted.

targets.heading: Step 2 — Pick what to break
targets.exportsCount: {fileName} exports {count} callable {count, plural, one {function} other {functions}}. Tick the ones the fuzzer should hammer.
targets.noFunctions: No exported functions found in this contract.

launch.heading: Step 3 — Launch the campaign
launch.description: Fuzzing {count} {count, plural, one {target} other {targets}} from {fileName}. Results land on the Runs page as crashes stream in.

done.title: Your fuzzer is off to work
done.description: Watch it live on Runs, then triage whatever breaks on the Triage board.

errors.noFile: Could not read that WASM file.
errors.atLeastOne: Pick at least one target to fuzz.
